lines.en: My feathers flutter in the snow wind.
I walk over the snow past the treeline.
Each step lands heavily.
My tail sweeps the snow behind me.

lines.zh: 几步之外，还有一群同伴。
lines.en: A few paces off, my pack follows.
I lower my head and sniff the snow.
There is little sound in the snowy woods.
I step around a fallen trunk.
It is warm under my feathers.
I walk with a whole pack.
A line of big prints is left in the snow.
I lift my head and look into the trees.
Footsteps are muffled in the snow.
I press slowly forward.
I stand, my feathers rising and falling.
A coat of down covers my back.
Snow lands on my shoulders and half melts.
My pack spreads out around me.
My chest rises and falls slowly.
The wind comes off the snowfield.
I keep my eyes open without blinking.
My pack waits together.
A clump of snow drops from a tree.
I am thinking about the next meal.
I shake my back.
This snowy wood is big enough.
I catch a hint of blood.
You are right in front of me.

lines.zh: 我们好几双眼睛都在看你。
lines.en: Several pairs of eyes are on you.
You move first.
I am far taller than you.
I am closing the circle.
Your hands are trembling.

lines.zh: 这片雪林的每道兽径我都走过。
lines.en: I have walked every game trail in this snow forest.
I follow step by step.
Do not hope to hide in the snow.

lines.zh: 羽毛被砍开一道，群却没有散。
lines.en: A gash opens through my feathers, but the pack doesn't scatter.
A wound shows through my feathers.
The pack drew in tighter.
Blood drips into the snow.
I reset my stance.
All my feathers cannot stop that.
This pack does not retreat.
The whole pack heard that.
Meat? Throw it here.
This smell is familiar.
One piece will not feed a pack.
I shoulder my way over.
Do not swing your hand.
I will take the first bite.
My pack is watching too.
This is too little.
This smells fresh.

lines.zh: 一块肉不够，让整群都分到。
lines.en: One piece of meat isn't enough to feed the whole pack.
I shoulder you over.
You roll several times.
Snow bursts up where I hit.
The trees rang with our collision.
I turn aside to let you pass.
Your frame is stout enough.
I reset my feet.
Try that again.
We hunt together.
You take the left; I take the right.
One call and the pack comes.
This snowy wood can feed a pack.
Feather against feather.
Our steps must fall together.
I guard the small ones.
The snow is deep. Go slowly.
If the wind is right, this is easy.
We close in together.
I stoop my head and take it.
One bite tears it open.
This piece is too small.
I swing my skull.
I can find what fell in the snow.
I will not eat it if it is not fresh.
Blood stains the snow.
I carry it away.
I leave some for the others.
I have found it.
I roared to call the pack.
The pack begins to close in.
I drop my chest low.
Snow crunches under my feet.
We come together.
Do not run into the trees.
You cannot outrun a pack.
I take the very front.
They come from the sides.
This distance will do.
Watch me, and you will not see behind.
I keep up the chase.
Where you go, I go.
There are footsteps behind you too.
The snow is deep, and you are slow.
I lift my head and sniff.
The circle is tightening.
The snow cannot hide prints.
Just ahead is the edge of the wood.
You are panting.
A packmate has gone around ahead.
Almost pressed against you.
This pack is patient.
Did you catch that sound.
Our footsteps.
Do not stop running.
I drive my forequarters in.
My teeth have closed.
My foreclaws pin you.
You are torn open in one slash.
A packmate lunges from the side.
The snow is churned to slush.
Blood on snow stands out.
You are still struggling.
I yield half a step back.
A second bite.
Blood is on my feathers.
This pack will not stop.

lines.zh: 雪林里站出来一个影子。
lines.en: A shadow rises in the snowy wood.
Feathers shake free of the snow.
I step out of the tree shadow.
Other footsteps sound around.
The Yixian cold is familiar.
I raise my head and scan.
A row of big prints appears in the snow.
The whole pack slowly spreads.

lines.zh: 雪林里，我的羽毛先冒出白气。
lines.en: In the snow forest, steam rises from my feathers first.
The wind ruffles my feathers.
I stand on the slope.
My shadow falls across the snow.
I remember this wood.
I wait, low in the snow.
The pack follows me.
Snow falls from the branches.
My feathers caught, and I beat at them.
I tumble down the snowy slope.
My feathers soaked up water and grew heavy.
The blast flipped my feathers back.
Something is lodged in my shoulder.
This force gets under my feathers.
There is too little prey in this snowy wood.

lines.zh: 雷打在雪坡上，一片白光。
lines.en: Lightning struck the slope in white light.
No snow here, and no trees.
